priya: quick async standup — kernel/kv/batch check-in
priya: What I did: landed prefetch backoff (stable), fixed a race in kv eviction that could drop hot keys under heavy bursts. Also adjusted continuous batching threshold.
priya: Blockers: seeing 95th percentile latency spikes in the long-sequence perf runs (seq=2048) after the prefetch change. Not sure if it's kv miss storms or batch fragmentation.
priya: Today: planning to run a bigger sweep (N=50, warmup=10) and then open a canary rollout at 10% if numbers look stable. Can someone eyeball the canary config? @david

david: ack, I can review around 14:30 PT. do you have the exact bench command / output?

priya: here's the runner command I used:
```
./bench_runner --model redwood-7b-q4 --seq 2048 --samples 20 --warmup 5 --batch-policy continuous --kv-mode enabled
```

priya: sample tail for last run (20 samples):  p50=43ms p95=512ms p99=890ms  (median looks fine, tails bad)

kai: those numbers smell like small-batch fallback after prefetch misses. If prefetch doesn't populate KV fast enough we end up with micro-batches and a synchronous fallback path.
kai: try running with `--batch-min 8 --prefetch-window 4` to force bigger microbatches; if tails shrink it's likely batch fragmentation.

maria: added a tiny repro script to gist: https://gist.github.com/maria/kv-tail-repro (contains a loop generating varying prefix reuse). Also tried shadow-cache mode: tails are present but attenuated. Suggests eviction churn contributes.

priya: good call. I'll run N=50 with kai's flags + shadow-cache enabled to isolate.

deploy-bot: canary deployment queued: redwood-runtime-canary v2026.11 -> 10% rollout pending manual approval by @david

david: approving after I review the metric diffs. prioritizing the tail reduction check.

priya: thanks — will post fresh numbers here when done. If anyone else wants early access to the repro, ping me and I'll share the test cluster creds. :pray:

kai: also leaving a quick note: if we need to revert prefetch backoff it's a one-line flag, we should keep that in the rollback playbook.

maria: no blockers from my side, will follow up with a short writeup once we pin root cause.

priya: last: small ask — codeowners for the batching config are @kai and @david, can you two coordinate the review?
